title: Common
description: Shared definitions for the Penjaga House Data Contract (M0). Referenced by every other contract schema.

ObjectId.title: ObjectId
ObjectId.description: Stable, unique, human-readable ID of a physical element: <kind-prefix>_<descriptor>, lowercase snake_case. The prefix must match the element kind (enforced by the semantic validator).

LevelIndex.title: LevelIndex
LevelIndex.description: Floor level index: 0 ground floor, increasing upwards.

StreamId.title: StreamId
StreamId.description: Concrete stream ID from the stream catalogue (streams.json), dot-separated, e.g. elec.circuit.circ_ac_master.current_a.

HouseTime.title: HouseTime
HouseTime.description: Instant in house time (see M4): an RFC 3339 date-time, which always carries an explicit UTC offset (validators must assert the format). Services emit +08:00 (Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

CalendarDate.title: CalendarDate
CalendarDate.description: Calendar date (RFC 3339 full-date, YYYY-MM-DD) in the house's local time zone.

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.description: Preventive layer: L1 leaks, L2 electrical safety, L3 appliance health, L4 maintenance, L5 management integration.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: Ordered severity scale. 'urgent' is reserved for safety (e.g. electrical hazard, burst pipe).

Quality.title: Quality
Quality.description: Per-sample quality flag. ok: valid measurement. missing: no value (value must be null). estimated: value filled or derived by the sensor/gateway. out_of_range: outside the stream's physical range (value kept as reported). stale: value repeated from an earlier sample because the sensor did not update.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description: A physical quantity with unit and optional 90% interval. Monetary values are never computed by detection; the M6 tariff calculator converts physical quantities to RM.

SpecBasis.title: SpecBasis
SpecBasis.description: design_target: a specification we require of the sensor we would buy. datasheet: taken from a specific product's datasheet.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Reference to an entry in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md (e.g. DS-007).
